Package com.sbancuz.offscreen.integration.mui2

@ParametersAreNonnullByDefault package com.sbancuz.offscreen.integration.mui2
Optional ModularUI 3 adapters and synchronized desktop-window factories.

For screens that update server state, register an OffscreenSimpleFactory on both client and server. For a purely local ModularUI screen, use OffscreenAPI, which selects the registered client adapter.

The historical mui2 package name is retained for API compatibility. The factory and request token identify which pending window should receive a server reply. The session attaches the returned screen during a client tick. Construction and close handshakes preserve Minecraft's one-active-container rule; separate desktop windows do not create additional server inventory ownership. Keep common panel builders free of client-only classes, and gate this package on ModularUI presence before loading its implementation.
